articles.summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR) today announced that Mark Ibbotson will join the company as Executive Vice President and Chief Store Operations Officer, effective September 14. Ibbotson brings decades of experience leading large-scale retail operations through periods of significant transformation. Through senior leadership roles at Walmart and its former U.K. subsidiary Asda, Ibbotson built a reputation as an operations specialist and innovator in omnichannel retail. "Mark has done this work at scale, and he has done it exceptionally well," said Greg Foran, CEO of Kroger. "He knows what it takes to simplify complex operations, bring out the best in frontline teams, and build the digital and physical capabilities that win with customers. That is what we need as we accelerate our momentum and build America's Best Grocer." articles.title: Kroger names Mark Ibbotson Executive Vice President and Chief Store Operations Officer

articles.summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR), America's Grocer, is helping customers eat healthier in the last few weeks of summer. Peak-season fruits and vegetables are fresher, more flavorful and more nutritious. When produce is harvested at the height of its season, it retains more of its natural vitamins, minerals and fiber than when it is picked early and transported long distances. And Kroger is making it more affordable to enjoy these nutrient-dense foods with $5 off a $20 produce purchase. What Kroger dietitians are recommending right now "The best thing about eating well in August and September is that the most nutritious foods are also the most delicious ones," said Laura Brown, MS, RD, LDN, director of nutrition at Kroger. "Peak-season produce is naturally higher in fiber, vitamins and antioxidants – and because it's so fresh, it's easy to enjoy." articles.summary: The all-new collection features 15+ pumpkin-inspired products to enjoy all day long. The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR), America's grocer, is welcoming fall with the launch of its limited-time Private Selection™ Pumpkin Harvest Collection, a seasonal lineup crafted to bring all the comforting flavors of autumn to every part of the day. The collection will be exclusively available across the Kroger Co. Family of Stores.* "That first crisp morning is the best sign that fall has officially arrived, welcoming in the warm flavors and spices that make this season so special," said Ann Reed, Group Vice President of Our Brands at Kroger.
